description: This file defines an Angular component 'TodoItemComponent' responsible for displaying and managing individual todo items, including toggling completion, editing, and removal.

classes.name: TodoItemComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a todo item, managing display and user interactions related to a single todo.

methods.name: toggleTodo
methods.description: Toggles the completed status of the todo.

methods.name: removeTodo
methods.description: Emits a removal event for the current todo.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Enters edit mode for the todo item.

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.description: Exits edit mode when input loses focus.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Sets the title field to the current todo's title when input gains focus.

methods.name: updateTodo
methods.description: Updates the todo's title or removes it if the title is empty.

methods.name: ngAfterViewChecked
methods.description: Automatically focuses the input element when editing.
